facts.fact: The finance ministry's budget monitoring unit reports that in July to December 2023 the existing transmission sites and connections at districts on the National Backbone Infrastructure were supported to provide IT services to the beneficiary institutions, and pictures a server at Mbarara District headquarters; it does not name the district offices connected.
facts.system: National Backbone Infrastructure (NBI) connections at districts

facts.fact: The finance ministry's budget monitoring unit, reporting on July to December 2023, speaks of connections at districts on the National Backbone Infrastructure and gives no count of districts or local governments connected; the 15 sites newly given internet access in the period were an airport, hotels, road tolls and an airline, none of them a local government.
facts.system: National Backbone Infrastructure (NBI) connections at districts

facts.fact: The finance ministry's budget monitoring unit reports that the National Information Technology Authority (NITA-U), a government vote, runs the national backbone, its district connections and the Government Network (GOVNET) deployment under the Digital Transformation Programme led by the ICT ministry, as at 31 December 2023.
facts.system: National Backbone Infrastructure (NBI) and Government Network (GOVNET) project

facts.fact: The Digital Transformation Programme's action plan under the third National Development Plan (2020/21 to 2024/25) carries an intervention to extend broadband countrywide and implement last-mile connectivity to key areas, listed as districts, sub-counties, schools, hospitals, post offices, tourism sites, police and local governments, and it was under implementation and monitored as at 31 December 2023.
facts.system: last-mile connectivity to key areas (NDP III Digital Transformation Programme)

facts.fact: The finance ministry's budget monitoring unit reports that by 31 December 2023 the extension of ICT infrastructure countrywide under the Uganda Digital Acceleration Project was not executed because its external funds were not released, pending World Bank disbursement approval, leaving NITA-U with 17.7% of its budget released; the last-mile study's terms of reference awaited World Bank clearance, while the GOVNET deployment output of Ug shs 4.464 billion had 49.2% of its budget received.
facts.system: Uganda Digital Acceleration Project (UDAP) / Government Network (GOVNET) project
